steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 15-second launch film for [your product], 16:9 at 1920x1080, from the "12-launch-reel-ember" template in lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates (MIT, rendered with HyperFrames).

Setup: clone https://github.com/lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates into ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates, then run `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 doctor` and fix anything it reports (it needs Node.js 22 or newer, FFmpeg and Chrome).

The film, scene by scene:
1. four kinetic words with a reply card whose copy counter ticks up
2. collapse to a line, ember ring, brand tile with sparks, wordmark with sheen
3. zoom into the tile, iris opens on a blurred wall of gallery cards
4. featured gallery prompt card + headline
5. chat composer typing a prompt, result chip, headline
6. composer collapses into a block that lands in the model grid
7. model grid tilts into 3D, image-topped bars rise, feature badges orbit
8. zoom and flash into three counting facts, vortex out
9. final lockup, tagline, button, domain

Before you change anything, learn [your product] from [your product URL] and ask me only for what you cannot find: its name, what it does in one line, the copy each scene needs, and two or three brand colours as #rrggbb. The demo brand, names, prices, numbers, ratings and quotes are placeholders: replace every one with something true for my product, or remove it. Never ship a made-up number or testimonial.

Then:
1. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/new-video.mjs 12-launch-reel-ember my-video`
2. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video` to list the variables.
3. Write values.json, keeping each value close to its default's length and format (the same number of |-separated items, plain numbers where the default is a number), then apply it with `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video values.json`.
4. `cd my-video && npx hyperframes@0.8.96 snapshot --at 1,5,10,14`, look at every frame, and fix any text that overflows or any colour that is hard to read.
5. `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 render -f 60 -q high -w 4 -o out.mp4`, then watch it through once before you hand it over.

Template notes: The brand tile is assets/brand-mark.png (the warm logo variant proposed with the site restyle). Swap the file to change the logo; model names in the grid are hard-coded in the script.
